answer.says: Sunil, your economy is precise. The samosa remains as a potentiality, unactualised. I accept the actuality of the tea; the potentiality I shall leave to the next man. It is a small dialectic in a glass.
answer.thought: The chai is hot, a fleeting spirit of the particular. I accept the gift with the dignity of a man who knows the value of a cup. The samosa waits, un-eaten, a pure possibility in a system of needs that prefers the actual. I have enough to last, but not enough to be generous.
